title: Images in HTML
description: Images are used to add visual content to a webpage and improve user engagement.
The tag is used to display images, while the src attribute specifies the image file location and the alt attribute provides a text description of the image.
Images help communicate information more effectively, enhance the appearance of a website, and create a better user experience.

example.output: Displays an image named 'cat.jpg' with a width of 300 pixels.
